notes.title: Hotfix 0.1.5 Released! - Major
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

We're thrilled to announce a major update for Tony Slopes™. 
The game has just undergone its most monumental update so far! 

We've been actively listening to all the feedback you've generously shared with us and have fine-tuned the game based on your invaluable input.

Without further ado, here's a glimpse of the enhancements that await you in the latest Tony Slopes™ update:

--------------------------------------------------------------

Menus:

- Bug Fix: Multiplayer Game Name text box is no longer infinite
- Bug Fix: Game Name display no longer off screen on wider resolutions
- Loading Screen Background images updated (after new track amendments)
- Map Unlock and Postcard images updated (after new track amendments)
- 'X' (Checklist Button) relocated on Map Selection screen (for easier playing experience)
- New game intro soundtrack variations
- New Game Cover Art and Main Menu background to highlight phase one of our rebranding. Phase 2 of the rebrand will be completed in our next update.

In-Game:

- All tracks now have a standard width road with track curbs to help guide players along the route
- Corners that were approached by rising roads have now been levelled out to allow players plenty time to prepare for the corner intensity
- Banked road surfaces have also been removed to eliminate bugs with vehicle physics
- All track surfaces have been smoothed out to allow for more steady gameplay
- All game music and sound effects have been normalised to eliminate spikes in sound
- Game audio settings default volumes reduced
- Multiple boost sound effects added for variation
- Pause Menu update to allow player to edit audio volumes in-game.
- Pause Menu update to allow players to pause the game before the race countdown
- Bug Fix: Pause Menu updated to not allow players to hit Respawn before the race countdown
- Bug Fix: Game no longer crashes after hitting Respawn during death animation
- Bug Fix: Turning off music no longer turns off sound effects as well
- Bug Fix: Players no longer spawning in the wrong location during multiplayer matchups.
- Bug Fix: Walking guards upright axis locked to prevent tilting animations
- Bug Fix: Guards no longer walking over collisions
- Bug Fix: Guards no longer getting stuck to the vehicle
- Bug Fix: Boat no longer sinking through the road!
- HUD updated with quick access panels showing controls for both keyboard and controller users
- Vehicle physics updated to prevent flicking up issues and glitching

Maps:

- AREA 52: Bridge texture updated
- AREA 52: Hangar ramp added
- AREA 52: Scene brightened
- BURNING DESIRE: Directional arrows removed as they were in line with the sun and caused collisions
- BURNING DESIRE: Smoother corners
- BURNING DESIRE: New track section
- DESERT STORM: Handful of guards removed from narrow track area as there were too many 
- DESERT STORM: Track length after large jump extended to allow time to land and turn the corner
- THE ICEBREAKER: Cave tunnel updated with interior lighting
- THE ICEBREAKER: Slide updated with new branding colours
- MALARIA MADNESS: Track length after first sprint extended and corner smoothed out
- OUT ON THE PISTE:  Track length after large jump extended to allow time to land and turn the corner
- OUT ON THE PISTE:  Bridge jump height reduced slightly to prevent players going over the edge to easily
- RING OF FIRE: Bug Fix: Level no longer crashing in multiplayer
- RING OF FIRE: First bridge jump height reduced slightly to prevent players going too fast towards the corner
- RING OF FIRE: Castle jump lava streams covered with grills to allow players more space for driving and landing
- RING OF FIRE: Mesh bridge jump height reduced slightly to prevent players going too fast towards the corner
- TANGLED TRAIL: Corner before finish line extended for smoother turning
- LOST VEGAS: Long straight after curved wall cleared of all obstacles to allow for an opportunity to boost without collisions. Corner at the end of this road also smoothed out.
- LOST VEGAS: Bridge jump height reduced slightly to prevent players going over the edge to easily

--------------------------------------------------------------

If you're enjoying the game and the fantastic new features, please take a moment to leave us a glowing review over on our Steam page. Your reviews help us reach more players and help us to continue to improve Tony Slopes™ for everyone's enjoyment.

--------------------------------------------------------------

Want to report a bug or an issue with your game? 
Please do so over on our Discord server under the 'Bug Reporting' Channel. 
https://discord.io/tonyslopes

We take all feedback seriously and do our best to make sure you have a smooth playing experience. (Please note, this game is still in Early Access).

Regards,
The Tony Slopes Team

notes.title: Hotfix 0.1.4 Released! - Major
notes.content:
Dear Gamers,

We are delighted to announce a major update which has been designed to enhance your gaming experience. Since the game's launch in February, we have been closely monitoring player feedback and identified concerns regarding the game's progression system.

We are excited to share that we have completely redesigned the game's flow to make it more enjoyable and streamlined for all our players. With the new changes, unlocking racers, vehicles, and maps has become quicker and more straightforward. While obtaining headgear items remains a challenge, we have introduced more flexibility and control into your experience. This means that you are no longer restricted to acquiring the headgear items before progressing to the next map. Instead, you can simply revisit maps at a later date and collect them whenever you need them.

Moreover, as part of the updated system, players now have quicker access to vehicles and racers in both solo and multiplayer modes. Your headgear will now serve as a symbol of your status, rather than being tied to a specific vehicle. The game's Final Challenge will be unlocked once you have successfully unlocked all 9 maps.

We would like to apologise to any players who may have had a negative experience with the game's progression system. We genuinely hope that these improvements will address those concerns and make Tony Slopes™ an even more enjoyable experience for all players.

Our team is committed to listening to our players' feedback and continually improving our game to provide the best possible experience. We would like to thank all of our players for their support, patience, and feedback. We also hope that any players who previously posted a negative comment on our STEAM page regarding the progression system will enjoy the new experience and consider rewriting their review as a positive one.

We encourage our community to connect with us on our Discord channel if you have any other comments, and we will do our best to respond to you as soon as possible.

Thank you for playing!

Regards,
The Tony Slopes™ Team

*PLEASE NOTE. If you have already installed the game, we highly recommend going to the Main Menu and selecting Options > Settings > System [TAB] and selecting 'Delete Profile' for a fresh new playing experience.
